title: FIX — Achiri test runner false-fail on '0 FAIL' + E2E timeout
description: Voice Handler reports '13 PASS, 0 FAIL' but test runner marks it failed because regex exclusion for '0 failed' is case-sensitive (misses '0 FAIL'). E2E Integration times out at 30s. Fix: case-insensitive exclusion pattern, increase E2E timeout to 60s.

tasks.title: Fix hasFail regex to be case-insensitive for '0 FAIL/0 failed' exclusion + increase timeout
